set.body:
Scheduling lane: later. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Interview-specific scientific work remains valid but follows the mapping preview; reuse measurement policy when this work resumes.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

THE PLUMBING THE CHIEF'S RULING ASSUMED DOES NOT EXIST. Measured by claude-storymodel4s-m1 on 2026-08-30 and independently verified by the chief before this bead was written:

  Conditional[ appears in interview/fixtures MAIN sources exactly twice: its own definition
    (Resolution.scala:295) and AiCompatibleScores.internalRatio (Scoring.scala:125).
  clearsThreshold is read only by Conditional.whenResolved (Resolution.scala:300).
  eventPurity, semanticization, otherEventDrift, redundancy, target and probeGain are computed
    straight from the assessments and NEVER SEE A PlacementResolution.
  Measured on the Birthday account: eventPurity is Observed(0.875), Coverage(18,18), IDENTICAL
    before and after the membership-routing change.

So routing unconcentrated mass into the excluded arm moves TWO published things -- the resolution summary and internalRatio -- not six. The six membership-gated figures keep publishing exactly as before, because NOTHING WIRES THE ABSTENTION TO THEM.

THE REASONING BEHIND THE ORIGINAL RULING STANDS: publishing a per-class metric for a unit belonging to no counted class is publishing a measurement we could not make. What was wrong was the assumption that the enforcement path existed. It does not, and building it is a design question, not plumbing:

  WHICH of the six should be conditional? They are not obviously alike -- probeGain counts units under a phase predicate, eventPurity is a per-class purity, redundancy is about repetition. 'Abstain when the account's placement is unresolved' may be right for some and wrong for others.
  ABSTAIN AT WHAT GRAIN? Per account, per unit, or per class? The current PlacementResolution is one summary per account (see bd-01M19GPDP08NHEW2S64ZNYPFPE for the per-metric variant).
  WHAT DOES AN ABSTAINING FIGURE PUBLISH? Option/None, an explicit Abstained case, or a Coverage that shrinks? The answer must not let 'we did not measure it' be read as 'we measured zero'.

Raised by m1, who declined to bundle it silently into a candidate authorized as 'the diff is the routing'.
set.title: [later] interview: the six membership-gated metrics have no conditional gate to abstain through
